::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 18th 1864  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 13-14
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_939.qmd),

I found the other day that Messrs [Longman](organizations/other_153.qmd)’s delay in transferring my books to you was rendering it difficult for the retail booksellers to procure them - I therefore wrote to them a day or two ago to urge on the completion of the arrangements and I hope you may soon be able to let me know that this has been done.

How soon do you think it would be advisable to begin printing the [Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd)? It will finish in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) in April or May. I would make a push for its doing so in April if this were best, and in that case I suppose you would begin printing at once and I would send you the other chapters- I have an alteration or two to make in what I sent you, but this can be done in the proofs.

My [brother](people/person_1624.qmd) mentioned to me the project of which you spoke to him of a little book of [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd),[^1] it is one that I should have much pleasure in carrying out

Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
